{{Quote|Black Sword Command defended the center of the Empire's Rim territories. Praxlis, Corridan, the entire Kokash and Farlax sectors.|[[Hiram Drayson/Legends|Hiram Drayson]]|<ref name="BtS" />}}
The '''Corridan sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It contained the [[Khadaji Singularity/Legends|Khadaji Singularity]] and the [[Jalorian Sodality]].

==History==
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the Corridan sector was located at the center of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] rim territories and was defended by the [[Sixth Negative Regions|Black Sword Command]].<ref name="BtS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Corridan was referred in only one line in ''[[Before the Storm]]'': "Black Sword Command defended the center of the Empire's Rim territories. Praxlis, Corridan, the entire Kokash and Farlax sectors." This left the nature of Praxlis and Corridan ambiguous. Praxlis and Corridan were interpreted as planets in the ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' and ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', but they were eventually stated to be sectors in [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].
